Default is "false" (before initialization). Switch this to "true"
(after initialization) if you would like to give init methods a chance
to populate constrained fields before they get validated.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"（初始化之前）。如果您希望在验证之前让初始化方法有机会填充受限字段，请在初始化之后将其切换为 "true"。

items.source: Simple BeanPostProcessor that checks JSR-303 constraint annotations in Spring-managed beans, throwing an initialization exception in case of constraint violations right before calling the bean's init method (if any).
items.translation: 简单的 BeanPostProcessor，用于检查 Spring 管理 Bean 中的 JSR-303 约束注解，在调用 Bean 的初始化方法（如果有）之前，若发生约束违规则抛出初始化异常。

items.source: Perform validation of the given bean.
items.translation: 对给定的 Bean 执行验证。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他BeanPostProcessor回调不同。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。
